{'worker_name': 'round_0001_worker',
 'round_id': 1,
 'candidate_id': 'ca1-pyramidal-fraction',
 'candidate_type': 'seed',
 'accepted_panel': {'members': [], 'best_panel_score': None},
 'scientific_question': 'Does lower representation of CA1 pyramidal neurons '
                        'mark donor-level memory decline beyond age, sex, '
                        'Braak stage, and CERAD burden?',
 'approach': 'Assign each segmented cell centroid to annotated regions, then '
             'compute a donor-level score as the proportion of classified '
             'cells in the target region labeled `Pyramidal Neuron`: '
             'n(Pyramidal Neuron in region) / n(all classified cells in '
             'region). Keep the operator fixed and test a small localization '
             'sweep by using CA1 alone versus the union of CA1 and CA2. If the '
             'denominator is too small for a stable proportion, return NaN.',
 'variations': [{'name': 'candidate_variant_a',
                 'description': 'CA1 pyramidal neuron fraction: count of '
                                '`Pyramidal Neuron` cells divided by all '
                                'classified cells assigned to CA1.'},
                {'name': 'candidate_variant_b',
                 'description': 'CA1_CA2 pyramidal neuron fraction: count of '
                                '`Pyramidal Neuron` cells divided by all '
                                'classified cells assigned to the union of CA1 '
                                'and CA2.'}],
 'baseline_variation': 'candidate_variant_a',
 'notes': 'Use `training_cohort.csv` to map donor_id to `slide_name`, then '
          'open the paired `.svs.zarr`. Assign regions from '
          '`SegmentationNode/centroids` using `CustomAnnotations` polygons '
          'after dividing annotation coordinates by 16. If a region has '
          'multiple polygons, use their union. Read cell-type labels from '
          '`ClassificationNode`; exclude unlabeled or unknown cells from both '
          'numerator and denominator. Handle low-count regions gracefully, '
          'e.g. return NaN if fewer than about 100 classified cells fall in '

 'rationale': 'With an empty panel, the strongest seed is a simple, '

              'class, and a CA1-focused neuronal proportion should capture '
              'local neuronal depletion or replacement by non-neuronal cells '
              'without relying on fragile image-derived modeling.'}
